GeneInput.description: An input classified before source resolution; aliases remain free text.

PathwaySource.description: One explicit pathway source, without fallback or cross-source title joins.

Text.description: Nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search Reactome (default) or WikiPathways human pathways. Membership names a source and release; it implies no therapy, response or actionability. No enrichment is calculated.

gene.description: Human gene input for exact resolution and UniProt mapping; Reactome only.

limit.description: Five rows by default, one to fifty. Reactome rows equals this limit without refill.

offset.description: Native Reactome Start row or retained WikiPathways catalog offset.

pool.description: Retained snapshot identity for deterministic continuation.

query.description: Literal source query; exclusive with gene and top-level discovery.

source.description: Sources in caller order; repeated sources take turns without title joins.

top_level.description: Native human Reactome top-level discovery, exclusive with text and gene.

title: PathwaySearch
